content:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach on dedicated pool eu-west-1-prod-pool-17 for model redwood-7b-quant. p95=870ms, p99=2300ms (SLO=1000ms). Queue depth rising. Paging oncall @alice_oncall. Incident ID: INC-3371234567

alice_oncall: on it. what's the visible customer impact? which routes/models? :eyes:

clara_runtime: seeing heavy queueing on that pool. per-route: /v1/generate (streaming) shows stall spikes, many requests waiting for slot handshake. current queue depth ~1200, inflight warmups ~18, warmup success rate ~34% in last 10m. handshake_fail=12% (registration timeouts)

dan_sre: any autoscaler events? did the pool try to add nodes and fail?

clara_runtime: autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups in last 7m but slot registration lagged ~45-90s each — handshake window expired and client requests sat in queue. logs show repeated "slot_registration_timeout" and "image_pull_slow" events.

ben_platform: confirming: cloud provider has transient ECR throttling in eu-west-1. image_pull_timeavg jumped to 70s. that explains slow container readiness.

alice_oncall: ok. immediate mitigation ideas? can we fallback to another pool or margin model variant?

clara_runtime: yes — we have two levers: 1) reroute traffic to eu-west-1-hotshot (has spare capacity) but will add cross-pool network hop. 2) fallback to redwood-7b-quant-light (faster cold start, lower memory) on same pool which bypasses heavy warmup kernels. both will reduce p99 quickly.

eva_support: which customers are impacted? I need a short list for CS to notify.

frank_cs: initial list from traces: cust-ACME, cust-ZETA, cust-ORBIT (high QPS clients). Impact window ~5m and ongoing. Some streaming sessions saw stalls and reconnects.

alice_oncall: execute fallback to light variant and start manual scale up. clara, can you run warmup for additional slots and set routing rule to fallback? I'll coordinate with ben for reroute if needed.

clara_runtime: running commands now:

```
# prewarm 20 slots with light variant
rictl warmup --pool eu-west-1-prod-pool-17 --model redwood-7b-quant-light --slots 20
# add slots (manual reservation)
rictl pools scale eu-west-1-prod-pool-17 --add-slots 20 --force
```

clara_runtime: warmup requests started. logs:

```
[warmup] 00:12:05 warmup(1) start model=redwood-7b-quant-light slot=42
[warmup] 00:12:18 warmup(1) ok slot=42
[register] 00:12:30 slot_registration ok slot=42
```

dan_sre: I'll watch autoscaler metrics and cloud image pull infra. if ECR continues to be slow we should switch to cached image in private registry.

ben_platform: starting a cross-pool reroute plan as backup. small percentage (10%) traffic -> eu-west-1-hotshot, can increase if stable. command:

```
rictl route adjust --from-pool eu-west-1-prod-pool-17 --to-pool eu-west-1-hotshot --percent 10
```

alice_oncall: enabling immediate fallback rule in routing policy (per-request):

```
# set fallback for streaming heavy routes
rictl policies set --pool eu-west-1-prod-pool-17 --fallback-model redwood-7b-quant-light --threshold p95>800ms
```

clara_runtime: fallback rule applied. seeing drop in handshake failures for new requests. p99 trending down: now 1.4s.

frank_cs: notifying customers now: "We're seeing transient stalls in eu-west. We've applied fallback and are scaling; some sessions may have experienced reconnects. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." :email:

eva_support: posting interim notice to status page and flagging impacted customers for 2hr follow-up.

ben_platform: manual scale completed, 20 slots added, but note: underlying container image pulls still slow for standard image. light variant uses smaller base so quicker.

clara_runtime: queue depth: 1200 -> 420 after fallback and scale. in-flight warmups still finishing, but streaming stalls reduced. p99 now 900ms, p95 650ms.

alice_oncall: great. are there any regression signals (error rates, mispredictions) with light variant? product risk?

harper_product: light variant reduces context window slightly and may change tokenization edge cases for some prompts. product: we'll run quick smoke tests on top-5 customer prompts. prioritize ACME.

clara_runtime: smoke tests OK for ACME sample set. no immediate quality alerts. continuing to watch eval metrics.

dan_sre: I've opened cloud support ticket for ECR throttling in eu-west-1. also spinning up a private image cache in region as a fallback. ticket: CLOUD-9987

alice_oncall: handoff plan: if p99 remains <1.0s and queue drains, we'll keep fallback in place for 30m, then attempt controlled rollback to primary variant with gradual ramp. if image pull throttling resolved, we'll revert.

clara_runtime: monitoring dashboards show sustained p99 <1s for last 6m. queue draining to normal (<50). I'll leave warmup jobs running to fill pool.

frank_cs: posted update to impacted customers. CS requests follow-up note with RCA and timeline once triage complete.

alice_oncall: adding action items:
- (A1) eng-platform: set up regional image cache + improve image pull retry/backoff logic (owner: ben_platform)
- (A2) eng-runtime: improve warmup backoff and registration visibility, add explicit handshake metrics (owner: clara_runtime)
- (A3) SRE: add autoscaler circuit-breaker to avoid repeated partial scale attempts piling queues (owner: dan_sre)
- (A4) docs: update runbook for fallback-to-variant step (owner: harper_product)

ben_platform: acknowledged A1, starting infra change request.

clara_runtime: acknowledged A2. I'll add instrumentation and a small alert for "registration_time > 20s".

dan_sre: acknowledged A3. will draft circuit-breaker playbook.

alice_oncall: final: incident state -> mitigated. p99 at 0.88s, queue depth 28, no active regressions. moving to post-incident review. handing off to night-oncall @pete_oncall for monitoring until 0200 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-3371234567 status=mitigated by alice_oncall, Clara_runtime, Ben_platform, Dan_sre. Participants: alice_oncall, clara_runtime, ben_platform, dan_sre, eva_support, frank_cs, harper_product, pete_oncall. Close time recorded. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems/ with RCA and action items.

alice_oncall: thanks team. I'll create the postmortem and include timelines and customer impact. closing thread.
